verdict.reason: Meio da Baia is worth a quick check for after work (16:30 start), but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide and timing are lining up well for this spot.

conversationalSummary.text: On TODAY, I’d check the cameras before leaving, because Meio da Baia after work is the best available option but the wind angle isn’t great for that spot. Surfline looks poor to fair, so I’m expecting it could be a bit hit-and-miss—there may be a decent window if the rising tide and the north-northwest swell line up cleanly in the bay. Use Surfline cams and the MEO Beachcam for Meio da Baia; if it doesn’t look noticeably better than expected, I’d skip.

best.explanation: Meio da Baia looks like a fun-sized window for Worth checking, Medium confidence: 0.6-0.9 m, 108 kJ, 8 s period, consistent 78/100, and wind is the main risk.  An inconsistent Baía spot that can work well when north-northwest swell reaches the bay; this is best for bodyboard sessions when the bay is clean, there is enough period and size, and the forecast shows a defined wave; 6-9s at mid tide can make exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia sharp and rippable.  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot.
